quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil and TGES to evaluate power solutions to support (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Wärtsilä and Tokyo Gas Engineering Solutions Corporation (TGES) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (in Helsinki, August 2026) to jointly evaluate gas- or dual-fuel engine-based power generation for selected data centre opportunities TGES is developing in Japan: developing initial technical concepts, establishing performance parameters and assessing the feasibility of selected projects (an evaluation framework, not an order). Anders Lindberg, President of Wärtsilä Energy: Wärtsilä has an evolving role in Japan's energy market, and delivering reliable power quickly is becoming a critical factor in enabling new data centre development.
